transcript.text:
Thank you all for your findings. Let me summarize what I'm hearing so we can move toward a decision:

1. **Privacy (Daniel):** The redline needs to include a 7-calendar-day deletion requirement post-termination, prohibitions on using customer content for model training and service improvement, and EU-only processing. These aren't yet in the contract redline.
2. **Insurance (Maya):** We need the vendor to maintain at least $5,000,000 in cyber-liability insurance and name our company as an additional insured, per our broker's written confirmation. This also needs to be verified against the vendor's draft and added to the checklist.
3. **Customer Contracts (Thomas):** Our enterprise customer's master agreement requires flow-down provisions — an annual audit right and uncapped indemnity for both confidentiality breaches and personal-data breaches. These haven't yet been incorporated into the vendor agreement.

Based on these findings, I cannot approve the agreement as currently drafted. All three sets of requirements — privacy, insurance, and flow-down provisions — need to be incorporated into the redline before I can give final approval. Daniel, Maya, Thomas — can each of you confirm you'll have your respective requirements added to the redline by end of this week? Once I see all provisions reflected in the updated draft, I'll conduct my final review.
